name: Adebisi Pelumi
story: My name is Adebisi Pelumi, a student of Ladoke Akintola University of Technology. I happened to come across this wonderful opportunity when i was l on the lookout for finding where i can learn a digital marketing skills, did some research and made some few inquiries about places i could learn from and the cost for learning was too high. Then one Faithfull day, It happened that a friend of mine invited me for an evening church service. I attended and that was where i happened to meet the great person that introduced me to the opportunity, it was explained to me that i will be making money in dollars and on-line.  It rounded so good to be true, decided to give it a trial and because she mentioned i get to learn digital skills for free, I decided to give it a try and it has been a great experience, learnt some few skills along side with schooling.  Schooling has been an easy journey because there are certain things i can do for myself without having to call home most of the time, in this journey also have been able to get myself a PC, pay my school fees even before collecting it from home and some other little fees in school...it has been a great experience but we haven't gotten to our destination yet. So, it will be a great journey also for you if you come on board and enjoy this experience together.  Thank You!
